name: Bengaluru Rural
headline: Child labour near the metro and schools without water or toilets.
summary: Bengaluru Rural sits next to the metropolis, which creates demand for cheap adolescent labour; labour sweeps rescued 145 children over three years in a Times of India report. A High Court audit flagged five schools here without drinking water or toilets. Child-rights groups worry about post-COVID children who never returned to school.

reasons.detail: Proximity to Bengaluru draws adolescents into unorganised work; labour sweeps rescued 145 children over three years.
A 2023 High Court report found five government schools in Bengaluru Rural without toilets.
Activists tie COVID school closures, job losses and unaffordable online-class costs to dropouts and then early marriage; the figures combine Bengaluru urban and rural, not rural alone.

Child protection officers in Bengaluru Rural stopped 66 child marriages in 2020-21 versus 12 in the prior two years, per a Deccan Herald report; girls out of school are quickly seen as ready for marriage.
A 2016 report listing Bengaluru Rural with 25 child marriage cases (2013-16) blamed poverty, limited education and low awareness for rising cases statewide; it is not specific to this district.
